remarks: Welcome to 240 The Village #102. Enjoy morning coffee on your patio, afternoons by the pool, and nearby harbor and beach outings from this inviting first-floor condo in South Redondo Beach. Located in The Village community, this one-bedroom, one-bath corner unit offers a comfortable coastal retreat with a versatile nook for a home office, study, or reading space. Expansive windows with angled overhead glass fill the living area with natural light, while plantation shutters and crown molding add character.
